description: Authorization outcomes, policy provenance and changes, audit writer health, bundle posture, exceptions, and permission divergence.

links.title: App Capacity
links.tooltip: GitHub App pool capacity and quota

panels.title: Successful Exchange Latency p95 by Identity
panels.description: The application observes exchange latency only for successful outcomes. Sparse identities may not have a stable percentile.

panels.title: Policy Cache Hit Ratio
panels.description: Policy lookup cache hit ratio for the selected range. Cache misses occur before singleflight coalescing and do not equal upstream fetches.

panels.title: Audit Writer Activity and Errors
panels.description: Processed audit events, JTI cache errors, and audit file errors. Processed does not prove file persistence or Loki ingestion; use Telemetry Health for delivery evidence.

panels.title: Provider Tokens Minted by App & Scope
panels.description: Shared-provider token minting, including internal policy-fetch tokens. Not consumer success and not a complete count of background tokens.

panels.title: Last Observed Retry-After
panels.description: Duration from the most recent secondary-rate-limit response. This gauge does not count down or prove the upstream recovered.

panels.title: Provider Tokens Minted — Top Repositories (range total)
panels.description: Repo-level token issuance count for the dashboard time range. `scope` is `org/repo`. Org-level scopes (no slash) are excluded — see the panel below.

panels.title: Provider Tokens Minted — Org-level Scopes (range total)
panels.description: Org-level token issuance count for the dashboard time range. `scope` is the org name (no `/`).

panels.title: Provider Tokens Minted per Scrape-Safe Window
panels.description: Rolling increase over Grafana's rate interval. It is not a disjoint interval count and includes internal provider callers.

panels.title: Provider Tokens by Repository / Policy Ceiling
panels.description: The permissions metric label is the trust-policy ceiling, not necessarily the requested or granted set. Use audit/trace evidence for actual grants.

panels.title: Total Provider Tokens Minted (range)
panels.description: Total token issuance in the dashboard time range.

panels.title: Distinct Repositories (range)
panels.description: Number of distinct `org/repo` scopes that received at least one token in the range.

panels.title: Distinct Orgs (range)
panels.description: Number of distinct org-level scopes that received at least one token in the range.

panels.title: Token Exchange Latency p99 by Identity
panels.description: p99 token exchange latency per identity (top 10). Complements the p95 view above by exposing tail latency that fast-path averages hide.

panels.title: Top Noisy Scopes (tokens/s)
panels.description: Top 10 scopes by token issuance rate. Useful to spot a single repo or org dominating traffic, or a runaway loop minting tokens.

panels.title: System Fault Ratio (range)
panels.description: Broker/dependency faults divided by all exchanges. Expected policy/authentication rejections are excluded.

panels.title: System Fault Ratio Over Time by Reason
panels.description: System/dependency fault outcomes only. Policy and authentication rejection trends remain in Security & Audit.

targets.expr: (sum by (github_app, scope) (increase(githubsts_github_tokens_issued_total{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",instance=~"$replica",github_app_instance=~"$app_instance",github_app=~"$app"}[1h])) > 0) unless on (github_app, scope) (sum by (github_app, scope) (increase(githubsts_github_tokens_issued_total{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",instance=~"$replica",github_app_instance=~"$app_instance",github_app=~"$app"}[1h] offset 1h)) > 0)

panels.title: Newly-Seen Scopes (last 1h, no activity in prior 1h)
panels.description: Scopes (app + repo/org) that received tokens in the last hour but had zero activity in the hour before. Governance signal: new caller appeared, or workflow renamed/relocated.

panels.title: Bundle & Policy Lifecycle
panels.description: The org Rego bundle: what is loaded, how old it is, whether it verified, and which policy revision is in force. These metrics are bundle-scoped and carry no github_app label, so the App and Instance pickers do not filter them.

panels.title: Bundle Enforcement by Replica
panels.description: Per-replica posture. Do not aggregate with max: one weaker replica must remain visible.

panels.title: Immutable Subject by Replica
panels.description: Whether OIDC immutable subject claims are demanded. Off means a renamed repository can keep matching a policy written against its old subject.

panels.title: Last-Updated Bundle Age
panels.description: Application gauge updated after a successful pull or during an exchange evaluation. It can freeze during quiet periods; do not treat it as current age until a pull timestamp metric exists.

panels.title: Bundle Pull / Verify / Reload Results
panels.description: The three stages of getting a bundle into memory. Verify failures are the security-relevant ones: the artifact was fetched but its cosign signature did not check out.

panels.title: Policy Revision Changes
panels.description: Each step is the org policy changing under a running broker. Correlate a spike here with a shift in denial rate before blaming the caller.

panels.title: Loaded Bundle Digest
panels.description: The exact bundle bytes in force, by digest. This is the forensic anchor: an audit event's bundle_digest should match a row here.

panels.title: Policy Revision
panels.description: Policy revision inside the loaded bundle, alongside its digest.

panels.title: Policy Exceptions by Status
panels.description: Standing exceptions to the org policy, by status. This is a gauge despite the _total suffix, so it reads as a current count rather than a rate.
Control signals already emitted by the application and previously absent from the dashboard.
panels.title: Control Exceptions & Divergence

panels.description: Differences between requested and GitHub-granted permissions. above_requested is a privilege-boundary fault; below_requested is fail-safe but breaks callers.
panels.title: Permission Divergence

panels.description: Requests evaluated against a stale bundle, separated into fail-open and fail-closed modes.
panels.title: Stale Bundle Evaluations

panels.description: Observed exchanges where a policy decision used an exception. Owner and rule dimensions are bounded by the configured bundle.
panels.title: Policy Exception Hits

panels.description: Seconds until exception expiry. Negative values are expired. Missing data can mean the feature is disabled or telemetry is absent.
panels.title: Exceptions Near or Past Expiry
